title: Volume of official development assistance flows for scholarships by sector and type of study
national_indicator_available: This indicator is not applicable to Rwanda.
national_indicator_description: This indicator concerns official flows (official development assistance plus other official flows) to be reported by donors. As Rwanda is not a donor, this indicator is not applicable. Some data for this indicator are available from the [SDG 4 Country Profile for Rwanda](https://download.uis.unesco.org/SDG4/SDG4-Profile-Rwanda.pdf) compiled by UNESCO.
indicator_definition: Gross disbursements of total official development assistance (ODA) from all donors for scholarships.
un_custodian_agency: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD)
